summary: Completed e2e testing of Terminology Settings Feature (Inclusive Language by Industry). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 6 features verified working via Playwright UI tests.

ui_bugs.issue: Industry badge doesn't update immediately after applying template - may require page refresh or OrgConfigContext refresh

1. Terminology tab in Settings.description: Tab appears and is clickable via [data-testid='terminology-tab']

3. Current terminology preview.description: Shows 10 key terms: Client, Lead/Prospect, Main Entity, Booking, Venue/Location, Pipeline, Deal, Quote/Proposal, Owner/Manager, Team Member

4. Preview Changes section with comparis.description: Shows Current vs New terminology when selecting different industry. Healthcare preview showed 'Patient' for 'Client'

5. Apply Terminology button.description: Button clicked successfully, API call succeeded, toast showed 'Terminology updated successfully'

6. GET /api/org-config/templates returns.description: Returns all 8 industry templates with name_en, name_es, description_en, description_es, enabled_engagement_types, default_engagement_type
